task.title: Add a managed preference
task.shortdesc: Add a known managed preference that is not yet configured in the profile.

prereq.p: Open All settings with the correct schema channel selected.

context.p: Managed preferences complement Firefox policies when BPM exposes a known preference key and lock behavior. Add them deliberately and validate the result.

step.cmd: Open the add preference control or find the preference in Catalog mode.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose the known preference key and review its expected value type.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Enter the value and lock state required by the profile.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Apply, validate, and save the managed preference.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The profile contains the new managed preference with the intended value and lock behavior.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the preference key is unknown or validation fails, remove the draft value and use JSON only for deliberate raw review.
